work-productivity-gog-google-workflow-helper v0.1.0

- Initial release providing workflow and support for Gog-style Google Workspace tasks.
- Supports practical help with bug fixes, reliability improvements, and creation of adjacent workflows.
- Designed for agent users and skill authors seeking repeatable, reliable productivity workflows.
- Includes triggers for keywords such as work-productivity, gog, google, workspace, cli, and specific Google Workspace apps.
- Outputs include tailored artifacts, checklists, and validation notes to ensure actionable and safe solutions.
